test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiomatic expression that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

He wanted to be a professional basketball player but given his height, __luck was against him.__

options.text: the cards were stacked against him
his health was not in his favour

solution:
The correct answer is: the cards were stacked against him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"luck was against him"** means that the circumstances were not favourable for him. (भाग्य उसके खिलाफ था)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite his hard work, **luck was against him**, and he couldn't secure the job.
 
 
 
• **"the cards were stacked against him" **is an idiomatic expression that means the odds were not in his favour or the situation was biased against him. (स्थिति उसके खिलाफ थी)
 
 
• **Example: **No matter how much he prepared, it seemed **the cards were stacked against him** in the final match.
 
 
 
• Hence, the phrase **"the cards were stacked against him"** is the most appropriate idiomatic expression to substitute the underlined segment.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **his health was not in his favour** (उसका स्वास्थ्य उसके पक्ष में नहीं था): This means that his physical condition was not supportive.

 
 
• **Example:** He trained hard, but his **health was not in his favour** during the tournament.
 
 
 
• **his principles were against him** (उसके सिद्धांत उसके खिलाफ थे): This means his own beliefs or values were not supportive of the situation.
 
 
• **Example: His principles were against him** when he had to make a morally tough decision.
 
 
 
• **the ball was against him** (गेंद उसके खिलाफ थी): This is not a commonly used idiom and does not fit well in the context.
 
 
• **Example:** This phrase is not typically used in standard English.
